newsitem.title: UK: Takefuji sets discount for share offer.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji sets discount for share offer.

text.p: Japan's Takefuji Corporation has set a discount of between 2.5 and 3.5 percent for its forthcoming international share offering, joint bookbuilder Daiwa Europe said on Tuesday.

The issue comprises an international tranche of 2.0 million shares and a domestic Japanese tranche of 1.0 million shares, Daiwa said. The consumer credit company's shares are traded on the OTC market, the bookbuilder said.
Official bookbuilding for the offer, which may be increased by up to 300,000 shares, begins today, with pricing expected between 13 and 18 March.
Daiwa Securities is global coordinator to the issue.Daiwa Europe and Morgan Stanley are joint bookrunners for the international tranche.
